title: Exotic Crispy Mexican Fish Pozole
description: A hearty and flavorful Mexican dish featuring crispy fish, Panang paste, and char-grilled yang, perfect for a hangover cure. This pescatarian-friendly pozole is a unique twist on traditional Mexican cuisine.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Panang paste and yang paste, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Add the hominy, diced tomatoes, and 2 cups of water, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, season the tilapia fillets with salt and pepper.
Char-grill the tilapia fillets until crispy and cooked through, about 5 minutes per side.
Flake the cooked fish into the pot and stir in the chopped cilantro and lime juice.
Serve the pozole hot, garnished with additional cilantro and lime wedges if desired.
